text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing Mission: Birthday<n>Party. Happy
birthday, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you, Bourbon. But if you're<n>with me,
you'll only be struck with<n>misfortune—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Beep. Inappropriate word detected:<n>"misfortune."
Strike one activated.<n>Two strikes left until
self-destruct<n>sequence activates.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! You mean... if I say the word<n>"misfortune,"
then Bourbon... you'll<n>explode?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Beep. Inappropriate word detected<n>again. One strike
left until—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I-I did it again! No... I don't want<n>to see you
blow up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon... I've always looked up to<n>you. I mean,
you're super fast and<n>super tough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I love everything about you,<n>Bourbon! Please
don't explode!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-are you okay, Bourbon? I didn't<n>say another
inappropriate word, did I?<n>Oh no... What if...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My self-destruct sequence has been<n>put on hold.
However... my happiness<n>levels are exploding.
